not_verified: Retained source_display only; original native pixels/branding/ports unchanged. Not a newly drawn 1536 master, OEM-CAD fit, installed configuration or new physical BOM object.
server_gpu identifies source chassis provenance, not GPU board/configuration. Mellanox SN2100 is Ethernet; historical filename switch_ib is not InfiniBand evidence.
Generic face dimensions are drawing coordinates. Source metadata/display/native pixel/actual 3D physical aspect were checked separately; low native resolution remains visible.
Discrete 1280/390 lightdark legacy0/35 and five modern isolation states; not every possible viewport/stage or authenticated research behavior.

Intentional intercepted503 and in-flight responses test fallback/retry/resource ownership, not a real production outage. Observation hooks only expose references/counters; product camera not assigned.
Prior Float32 numerical observer failure and real border-box content distortion preserved. Candidate module interception was prospective validation only; final public run used deployed exact source.

The V3 actual retry timed out without handle/network diagnostic; cause remains unknown. V4 retained the same 30s retry condition and passed all five actual retries; a failure-only diagnostic catch was independently reviewed and will be saved with TA35 source.

Legacy mobile controls overlay the underlying rack; these compatibility screenshots do not establish unobstructed full-rack mobile geometry acceptance. The independently opened source viewers were complete and readable.
No denied local product URL, local HTTP/server or local product JavaScript execution. GitHub final-head checks actual; no bypass. Existing AWS timer only observed. No Spark/research mutation.
